# Aibooking.dk

> Aibooking.dk is a Danish AI reception and booking platform. It combines an AI chat/voice widget for websites and webshops, an AI phone assistant that handles inbound and outbound calls, and automatic calendar booking, so businesses never miss a call, chat, order, or booking request — 24/7. Each AI agent speaks one of six languages: Danish, English, German, Spanish, French or Portuguese.

Aibooking.dk is aimed at small and medium-sized Danish businesses — clinics, craftsmen, offices/admin teams, and webshops — that want to automate reception, sales and booking without hiring additional staff. The product connects the website widget, phone assistant, and booking calendar into one system so customer contact is never lost between channels.

The AI voice/chat widget embeds on any platform (WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Magento or a custom site) and acts as an extra employee: on ordinary business websites it books and reschedules appointments and collects quote requests and leads straight into the owner's calendar; on webshops it behaves like an upgraded version of the platform's native chat, letting customers track orders, reorder products, check stock and get help mid-purchase by voice or text.

The AI introduces itself as an AI at the start of every conversation, as required by article 50 of the EU AI Act.

Trying the product is free: new customers create a free account (no credit card required) at https://app.aibooking.dk/signup and get a 7-day trial before choosing a paid package. Existing customers manage their account, agents and subscription from the same dashboard, at https://app.aibooking.dk/dashboard.

## Languages

The whole site, including every blog article, exists in five languages, each written for its market rather than translated word for word. Danish URLs have no prefix; the other languages add a prefix to the same path, for example https://www.aibooking.dk/en/funktioner.

- [Dansk](https://www.aibooking.dk/): Danish (primary market, prices quoted in DKK).
- [English](https://www.aibooking.dk/en): English (also the default for other countries).
- [Español](https://www.aibooking.dk/es): Spanish.
- [Deutsch](https://www.aibooking.dk/de): German.
- [Français](https://www.aibooking.dk/fr): French.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.aibooking.dk/): Overview of the AI receptionist product and core value proposition, with a quick price estimate (industry, talk time, what the AI should handle).
- [Features](https://www.aibooking.dk/funktioner): Full feature list — call handling, calendar integration, reminders, dashboard.
- [Chat & voice widget](https://www.aibooking.dk/widget): The AI chat and voice widget for websites and webshops (text chat, dictation and real-time voice; bookings; product, stock, shipping, returns and order-status answers on Shopify), with a link to the price calculator.
- [AI-receptionist](https://www.aibooking.dk/ai-receptionist): The AI receptionist product page — AI voice widget on the website, AI phone answering for inbound calls and outbound calls (add-on), combined in one solution with one dashboard.
- [The app](https://www.aibooking.dk/app): The customer app for phone and computer — calls, bookings, recordings, transcripts and usage in one place, with real screenshots and how to add it to the home screen.
- [Price calculator](https://www.aibooking.dk/prisberegner): Choose industry, phone talk time, website-widget usage and what the AI should handle (booking, webshop, food delivery) to see an estimate and an example dashboard, then ask for a quote. Prices are not published on the site; the calculated price is shown once a quote has been requested.
- [Free Trial](https://www.aibooking.dk/proeveperiode): Details of the 7-day free trial, started by creating a free account — no credit card required.
- [Demo](https://www.aibooking.dk/demo): Book a free, no-commitment demo.
- [Integrations](https://www.aibooking.dk/integrationer): Supported calendar and communication integrations.

## Industries

- [Industries overview](https://www.aibooking.dk/brancher): Which industries the product serves.
- [Clinics](https://www.aibooking.dk/klinik): AI reception for healthcare clinics — booking, reminders, fewer no-shows.
- [Craftsmen](https://www.aibooking.dk/haandvaerker): AI phone assistant for tradespeople who can't answer calls mid-job.
- [Hair & beauty salons](https://www.aibooking.dk/frisoer): AI receptionist for hairdressers, barbers and beauty salons — books, moves and cancels appointments while the stylist works.
- [Restaurants & takeaway](https://www.aibooking.dk/restaurant): AI phone agent and website chat for restaurants, pizzerias and takeaways — table bookings in the calendar, menu and allergen answers from the knowledge base, and courier delivery booked with Uber Direct or Just Eat. No payment or hand-off to a till.
- [Office & Admin](https://www.aibooking.dk/kontor): AI reception for offices and administrative teams.
- [Webshops](https://www.aibooking.dk/webshop): AI widget and support automation for e-commerce.
- [Shopify AI](https://www.aibooking.dk/shopify): Shopify integration for the chat/voice widget and the AI phone agent — live product search, variants and stock, shipping and returns policies, and order status by order number. Read-only: no cart, checkout, payment or order changes.
